Spring Grapple.name: Spring Grapple
Spring Grapple.description: The user forms a spring-loaded launcher with a hooked line and fires it at a ledge, a beam or a rooftop. They reel themselves up a building face or swing across a street-wide gap carrying a passenger, then leave the line anchored as a zip line that lowers trapped people to the ground one after another. Strain: moderate.
